verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a genuine self-host mode — 'runs on your own hardware... single self-contained binary' with local embeddings/LLM — but explicitly state 'No Docker' and describe a closed single-binary distribution rather than open-source code the engineer builds/deploys via Docker. The GitHub repo evidence in the pack only documents connectors/extractors, not that the self-host binary itself is open-source or containerized. missing for 10: Docker/container deployment path, confirmation the self-hosted binary is built from open-source code (license/repo), and independent hands-on verification of self-host setup.
